findings.F1: Sense 1 definition says 'uncountable noun' and 'not much' instead of 'plural noun' and 'not many'.
findings.F2: The usage note gives the comparative and superlative as less/least (less people) instead of fewer/fewest.
findings.F3: The sense 2 example 'Could I borrow a few money?' is ungrammatical; money is uncountable.

missed: Neutral few after a determiner (the last few days, every few minutes, the few friends I have) is covered by neither sense.
